claim_en: Google Cloud, TSMC and Microsoft each name accelerator cooling as a problem to solve, in their own material.
claim_zh: Google Cloud、TSMC、微软都在自己的材料里把加速器散热列为要解决的问题。

claim_en: AMD MI355X typical board power 1400 W; NVIDIA DGX B200 up to 1000 W per GPU; H100 SXM 700 W.
claim_zh: AMD MI355X 板卡功耗 1400 W；NVIDIA DGX B200 每颗 GPU 最高 1000 W；H100 SXM 为 700 W。

claim_en: Acceptance metric: OCP cold-plate test specification, case-to-coolant-inlet thermal resistance at several flow rates.
claim_zh: 验收指标：OCP 冷板测试规范，多个流量下壳到冷却液入口的热阻。

claim_en: No primary evidence that buyers need a new material; buyer-side sources point to cooling architecture (microfluidics, liquid cooling, removing the TIM layer).
claim_zh: 没有一手证据表明买家需要新材料；买家一侧都指向冷却架构（微流体、液冷、去掉导热界面层）。
note: gate Q4 failed; direction moved to watch

claim_en: Akash (supplier) reports a $27M contract with NxtGen for diamond-cooled servers; diamond type and position not disclosed, no independent test.
claim_zh: Akash（供应商）称与 NxtGen 签了 2700 万美元的金刚石散热服务器合同；金刚石类型和位置未公开，没有独立测试。

claim_en: 62 models re-scored on κ_SRME; every leaderboard value matches to rounding; per material identical to the official logic.
claim_zh: 62 个模型的 κ_SRME 重新计分，和排行榜全部一致；逐材料和官方逻辑完全相同。

claim_en: For 6 of 7 commercially relevant materials, the DFT reference is 10–27% below measurement (BAs within range).
claim_zh: 7 个有商业意义的材料里，6 个的 DFT 参考值比实测低 10–27%（BAs 在实测范围内）。

claim_en: Cubic BAs measured at 1000–1300 W/m·K in 2018, after a 2013 computational prediction.
claim_zh: 立方 BAs 在 2018 年测得 1000–1300 W/m·K，此前 2013 年由计算预测。

claim_en: BAs, cBN and BP crystals are still millimetre-scale or smaller.
claim_zh: BAs、cBN、BP 晶体仍是毫米级或更小。

claim_en: GaN–diamond interface thermal resistance commonly 20–30 m²K/GW; CTE mismatch 5.6 vs 0.8 ×10⁻⁶/K.
claim_zh: GaN–金刚石界面热阻常见 20–30 m²K/GW；热膨胀系数 5.6 对 0.8 ×10⁻⁶/K。

claim_en: In the better half of the leaderboard, 28 of 31 models give the same top 10; but the test set's top 10 sits 25% above rank 11.
claim_zh: 排行榜较好的一半里，31 个模型有 28 个前 10 名相同；但测试集前 10 名和第 11 名差 25%。

claim_en: A tetrahedral-and-light-atoms rule finds 6 of the top 10 but ranks BAs 21st; every model with SRME < 0.2 puts BAs in its top 5.
claim_zh: "四面体结构、轻原子"规则找到前 10 名里的 6 个，但把 BAs 排在第 21；SRME < 0.2 的模型都把 BAs 排进前 5。

claim_en: One AI-related cooling material made and measured (152 W/m/K), per the series.
claim_zh: 按系列文章：一种与 AI 相关的散热材料已做出并测过（152 W/m/K）。
note: not checked against a primary source

claim_en: Volkswagen: industry-standard target for this development phase is 700 charging cycles with at most 20% capacity loss; no test conditions stated.
claim_zh: 大众：这一开发阶段的行业标准目标是 700 次充电循环、容量损失不超过 20%；没有写测试条件。
note: battery evidence gate Q3; was a series claim

claim_en: The 10⁻³ S/cm threshold used in the backtest is a research screening threshold, not a buyer standard; the battery gate found no buyer-side conductivity threshold.
claim_zh: 回测用的 10⁻³ S/cm 是研究筛选阈值，不是买家标准；电池关卡没有找到买家侧的电导率门槛。

claim_en: QuantumScape: A0 samples shipped in 2022, B1 samples from Q3 2025, about 2.5–2.8 years (the series said about two).
claim_zh: QuantumScape：A0 样品 2022 年发出，B1 样品 2025 年第三季度开始发出，约 2.5–2.8 年（系列文章写的是约两年）。

claim_en: OBELiX: 599 synthesised lithium solid electrolytes with measured room-temperature conductivity, 321 with CIF; CC BY 4.0.
claim_zh: OBELiX：599 种已合成的锂固态电解质，带室温实测电导率，321 种有 CIF；CC BY 4.0。

claim_en: Within known families (random folds), screening with prior data needs 5 experiments to find 5 hits, against about 30 at random.
claim_zh: 已知家族内（随机分折），用先验数据筛选找到 5 个过线材料要 5 次实验，随机约 30 次。

claim_en: With whole doping series held out, screening needs 7.6–12.9 experiments and beats the chemical-family rule by only 3–4.
claim_zh: 把同一掺杂系列整个留出后，筛选要 7.6–12.9 次，只比化学家族规则多省 3–4 次。

claim_en: A 'test sulfides first' rule closes 50% (official split) and 77% (cv5) of the gap between random and the best method.
claim_zh: "先测硫化物"规则关上随机到最好方法差距的 50%（官方划分）和 77%（cv5）。

claim_en: Transfer to a new family works for sulfides and fails for oxides; it cannot be predicted in advance.
claim_zh: 迁移到新家族：硫化物有效，氧化物失效，事先看不出来。

claim_en: RL (one trained policy per split) shows no stable advantage over screening.
claim_zh: 强化学习（每个划分只训练一个策略）没有稳定优于计算筛选。

claim_en: Microsoft/PNNL: AI-screened Na₂LiYCl₆ measured 2.2×10⁻⁶ S/cm at 100 °C, about three orders of magnitude below 10⁻³ S/cm.
claim_zh: 微软/PNNL：AI 筛选出的 Na₂LiYCl₆ 在 100 °C 下测得 2.2×10⁻⁶ S/cm，比 10⁻³ S/cm 低约三个数量级。
note: preprint; link to the series claim is an inference

claim_en: 73 models re-scored on WBM; all 146 leaderboard metric sets match; per structure identical to the official implementation.
claim_zh: 73 个模型在 WBM 上重新计分，146 组排行榜指标全部一致；逐结构和官方实现相同。

claim_en: At a 1% budget (2,155 of 215,488), 48 models pick at least 95% DFT-stable structures, against 15.5% at random.
claim_zh: 1% 预算（215,488 个里挑 2,155 个）下，48 个模型挑到至少 95% DFT 稳定的结构，随机只有 15.5%。

claim_en: Wasted share of a 1% budget: 1.5% (best model), 3.0% (CHGNet), 13.4% (MACE-MP-0).
claim_zh: 1% 预算里浪费的比例：1.5%（最好模型）、3.0%（CHGNet）、13.4%（MACE-MP-0）。

claim_en: Candidates predicted just below the hull: top models right about 90% of the time, CHGNet 39%, MACE-MP-0 47%.
claim_zh: 预测刚好在凸包下方的候选：前列模型约 90% 对，CHGNet 39%，MACE-MP-0 47%。

claim_en: New structure types (judged before relaxation) are 2% of candidates; top-10 recall on them is 1–4 points lower.
claim_zh: 新结构类型（按弛豫前判断）只占候选的 2%；前 10 名在其上的召回率低 1–4 个百分点。

claim_en: CSP benchmark: template method TCSPv3 top-1/top-20 67.8%/90.6% vs CrystalFlow 63.9%/72.2%; no random-removal control; the authors' lab develops TCSP.
claim_zh: CSP 基准：模板方法 TCSPv3 top-1/top-20 为 67.8%/90.6%，CrystalFlow 63.9%/72.2%；没有随机移除对照；作者实验室就是 TCSP 的开发者。
note: preprint v2; checked against the text

claim_en: GNoME: 736 predicted structures independently realised in experiments (lower bound).
claim_zh: GNoME：736 个预测结构被独立实验实现（下限）。

claim_en: Critique of GNoME: almost no compounds meet novel, credible and useful at once.
claim_zh: 对 GNoME 的批评：几乎没有化合物同时满足新颖、可信、有用。

claim_en: CFS ordered more than 10,000 km of HTS tape from Fujikura (30 Sep 2026).
claim_zh: CFS 向 Fujikura 订购超过 1 万公里高温超导带材（2026-09-30）。

claim_en: Buyer threshold: current at a given field and temperature, piece length, price per kA·m, per the series.
claim_zh: 按系列文章：买家门槛是指定磁场和温度下的电流、单根长度、每千安·米价格。

claim_en: AI-related new superconductors so far have Tc below 7 K, self-reported, per the series.
claim_zh: 按系列文章：AI 相关的新超导体临界温度在 7 K 以下，作者自测。

claim_en: DeepMind × CFS partnership announced 16 Oct 2025: TORAX simulation, operating-path search, RL control as a research direction.
claim_zh: DeepMind × CFS 合作于 2025-10-16 宣布：TORAX 模拟、运行路径搜索、强化学习控制（研究方向）。

claim_en: RL plasma control on TCV: trained in a simulator, deployed zero-shot on the device.
claim_zh: TCV 上的强化学习等离子体控制：在模拟器里训练，零样本部署到装置上。

claim_en: TORAX entered CFS's daily workflow in about one year, per the series.
claim_zh: 按系列文章：TORAX 约一年进入 CFS 日常流程。

claim_en: Logic-chip threshold: contact resistance ≤ 10 Ω·μm (lowest reported 42), per the series.
claim_zh: 按系列文章：逻辑芯片门槛是接触电阻 ≤ 10 Ω·μm（已报道最低 42）。

claim_en: Into logic chips about 2041 on the imec roadmap, per the series.
claim_zh: 按系列文章：按 imec 路线图约 2041 年进入逻辑芯片。

claim_en: MC2D: 3,077 compounds, 2,004 easily exfoliable; CC BY 4.0.
claim_zh: MC2D：3,077 种化合物，2,004 种易剥离；CC BY 4.0。

claim_en: Toyota, Samsung SDI, Volkswagen (PowerCo) and BMW each list all-solid-state batteries as a development goal in their own releases.
claim_zh: 丰田、三星 SDI、大众（PowerCo）、宝马都在自己的新闻稿里把全固态电池列为开发目标。

claim_en: Samsung SDI plans mass production in 2027 at 900 Wh/L; Toyota–Idemitsu target 2027 or 2028; PowerCo licensed for up to 40 GWh a year (option 80).
claim_zh: 三星 SDI 计划 2027 年量产、900 Wh/L；丰田与出光目标 2027 或 2028 年；PowerCo 获授权最多每年 40 GWh（可选 80）。
note: gate Q2; plans, not yet adoption

claim_en: USABC cell targets with conditions: 300 Wh/kg, 700 Wh/L, 1,000 DST cycles, 10-minute fast charge to 80% at 30 °C; generic EV targets, no electrolyte or conductivity target.
claim_zh: USABC 带条件的电芯目标：300 Wh/kg、700 Wh/L、1,000 次 DST 循环、30 °C 下 10 分钟快充到 80%；通用电动车目标，没有电解质或电导率指标。
note: gate Q3; carmaker consortium, not a standards body

claim_en: Toyota: the biggest challenge is durability — cracks between electrodes and solid electrolyte; working with Idemitsu since 2013 on a crack-resistant electrolyte.
claim_zh: 丰田：最大的挑战是耐久性——电极和固态电解质之间产生裂纹；自 2013 年起和出光合作开发抗裂电解质。
note: gate Q4: the named material limit is interface durability, not conductivity

claim_en: Volkswagen: the next step is to perfect and scale manufacturing processes; BMW: Solid Power will supply sulfide electrolyte to Samsung SDI (no payment stated).
claim_zh: 大众：下一步是完善并放大制造工艺；宝马：Solid Power 将向三星 SDI 供应硫化物电解质（没写付款）。
note: gate Q4: the buyer side also names manufacturing

claim_en: Battery commercial evidence gate: Q1–Q3 pass (Q3 with caveats), Q4 passes but the named limit is interface durability; no buyer-side conductivity threshold.
claim_zh: 电池商业证据关卡：Q1–Q3 过（Q3 有保留），Q4 过但点名的限制是界面耐久性；没有买家侧的电导率门槛。

claim_en: In the CSP paper's released results, the ABC2D6 and PEROV arms share one recipe; removing a further 1,268 perovskite-framework structures loses 5 of 8 consensus recoveries and gains none. Less data and single-run noise are not ruled out; a size-matched random control was pre-registered; it has since been run (E048).
claim_zh: CSP 论文公开结果里，ABC2D6 组和 PEROV 组训练方案相同；再去掉 1,268 个钙钛矿框架结构，8 个一致恢复丢了 5 个、一个没多。数据变少和单次训练波动没有排除；同等规模随机对照已预登记，之后已运行（E048）。
note: recomputed from the paper's per-target file (commit 631c765)

claim_en: Size-matched random-removal control, pre-registered, 3 training seeds per arm, our EquiCSP runs: relaxed consensus on the 11 1:1:2:6 targets is 8, 8, 8 with 1,268 random structures removed, against 3, 4, 4 with the 1,268 perovskite-framework structures removed. Pre-registered outcome: template_specific. 11 targets and one model; it does not show which structures matter.
claim_zh: 同等规模的随机移除对照（预登记，每组 3 个训练种子，我们自己跑的 EquiCSP）：11 个 1:1:2:6 目标的弛豫后 consensus，随机去掉 1,268 个结构是 8、8、8，去掉 1,268 个钙钛矿框架结构是 3、4、4。预登记的结论：模板特有。只有 11 个目标、一个模型；没有说明是哪些结构起作用。
note: rules committed before training (4220c46, 36067ae); permutation p = 1/20, the minimum for 3 vs 3

claim_en: Pre-registered extrapolation test, Stage 1 on WBM: the top 10 MP-only models keep their stability ranking on candidates whose initial framework is absent from MP (median ratio to interpolation 0.94, 95% interval 0.87-1.04; 1,109 candidates, 37 frameworks with a stable one) and on unfamiliar chemical systems (1.07). The prototype-only baseline Wrenformer drops (ratio 0.58). After a post-hoc fix to the framework key (398 structures were known frameworks), the structural ratio is 0.91 (0.81-1.03), still holding but close to the 0.8 threshold. Substitution-derived candidates only; 'far' is mild.
claim_zh: 预登记的外推检验第一阶段（WBM）：只用 MP 数据训练的前 10 名模型，在初始框架不在 MP 里的候选上，挑稳定结构的能力基本保住（与插值之比的中位数 0.94，95% 区间 0.87–1.04；1,109 个候选，37 个含稳定候选的框架）；化学体系陌生时也是（1.07）。只看组成和原型的基线 Wrenformer 明显下降（0.58）。事后修正框架键后（398 个结构其实是已知框架），结构外推的比值是 0.91（0.81–1.03），仍然成立，但接近 0.8 的门槛。候选都来自元素替换，“远”是温和的远。
note: rules committed before scoring (ffdb574); Stage 1 alone does not change D10

claim_en: Pre-registered extrapolation test, Stage 2 on Alexandria (1,800 sampled structures, 300 stable per cell, unstable ones within 0.1 eV/atom of the hull): four MPtrj-only models (CHGNet, MACE-MP-0, SevenNet-0, MatRIS-10M-MP) keep their ability to separate stable from unstable structures when the framework is absent from MP but the chemistry is familiar (median ratio of Somers' D to interpolation 0.97, 95% interval 0.80-1.19; 90 frameworks with a stable structure). It also holds without the two ML-potential pre-screened sources (0.95, 0.83-1.14). When chemistry and framework are both unfamiliar it is partial (0.91; 0.72 without those sources). Starts from DFT-relaxed structures; no template baseline; lower bound just above 0.8.
claim_zh: 预登记的外推检验第二阶段（Alexandria，抽样 1,800 个结构，每格 300 个稳定，不稳定的都在凸包以上 0.1 eV/atom 以内）：四个只用 MPtrj 训练的模型（CHGNet、MACE-MP-0、SevenNet-0、MatRIS-10M-MP）在框架不在 MP 里、化学体系熟悉的结构上，基本保住分开稳定和不稳定结构的能力（Somers' D 与插值之比的中位数 0.97，95% 区间 0.80–1.19；90 个含稳定结构的框架）。去掉两个用机器学习势预筛的来源后也成立（0.95，0.83–1.14）。化学和框架都陌生时为部分成立（0.91；去掉两个来源后 0.72）。从 DFT 弛豫后的结构出发；没有模板式基线；区间下限刚过 0.8。
note: rules and sample committed before any prediction (c3f5fd2); one MatRIS relaxation failed (out of memory), outcome unchanged without it
